mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting and controlling the reactor was most worthwhile: the explanation of metering and removing reaction heat made the equipment's purpose clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the catalyst was sensible but brief, and the single available combination left little to decide.

surprise.text: The first methane arrived mixed with water vapour and unreacted gases, rather than being immediately usable as rocket fuel.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless; each action had a clear role, though every decision offered only one combination.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the mixed test gas becomes usable fuel and how the discovery reaches Earth; the physical explanations make that progression interesting.
